name: RothGPT
description: RothGPT models your complete retirement-account lifecycle — through owner distributions and the 10-year inherited-IRA period — to get Roth conversion decisions precisely right. Ask in plain English, and it returns the recommended conversion amount and tax bracket, the present-value gain — the wealth the conversion creates, in today's dollars — and its components (tax-rate arbitrage, RMD tax-drag avoided, and Medicare/IRMAA impact), the conversion and distribution tax rates, the after-tax Roth value, and the conversion IRR versus your portfolio benchmark. Drill into the full bracket-by-bracket ladder or year-by-year projections for any conversion level.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RothGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RothGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://rothgpt-mcp.onrender.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RothGPT MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RothGPT provides these MCP tools: get_conversion_ladder, get_inputs, get_year_detail, and run_conversion_analysis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RothGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RothGPT in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
RothGPT requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
